candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is undefined. AuthService.register doesn't set a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees user.provider !== 'email' and throws 422 needLoginViaProvider:google.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google. Optionally also set provider explicitly in AuthService.register.
